findings.ac: Stress Cases: Missing transitive reference causes build.py to exit with status 1
findings.text: test_missing_cited_reference_is_a_fatal_build_error calls build.closure_for directly with a DIRECT citation ('see references/does-not-exist.md') against an empty tmp_path, so the transitive case (a present reference that cites a missing one, the queue.extend branch) is never exercised. It also asserts only `exc.value.code not in (0, None)` (the code is a message string), never status 1, and never runs `python build/build.py` as a subprocess, so a change to sys.exit(2) or a build_bundle/emit_skill path that swallows the exit would still pass.

findings.ac: tests/install-harness passes 100% against the new canonical bundle
findings.text: Only run-L1.sh/.ps1 were migrated to dist/skills. The Antigravity L2 cells (run-L2.py assert_tree antigravity branch expecting plugins/stratosphere-os/plugin.json and scripts/scaffold.py, prompts/antigravity-global.txt and antigravity-local.txt calling scripts/install-antigravity.*) still target the retired dist/antigravity skills/scripts tree, since install-antigravity.sh requires dist/antigravity, which now holds only plugin.json. Those cells cannot pass against the new bundle and nothing asserts they do.

findings.ac: python build/build.py succeeds with zero errors and emits exactly 26 skill directories in dist/skills/
findings.text: No pytest runs build.py or checks its exit code; test_single_bundle_emits_exactly_26_skills only counts dirs holding SKILL.md in the committed dist/skills, and a stray extra directory without SKILL.md is not detected. Zero-error build and freshness rely on scripts/check.sh (build + git-status drift check), which is outside the test suite and was not changed by this slice.
